title: Research Source Coverage
dataSources: Tree records (`genealogy:record`), DNA matches (`dna:match`), ancestor events (`ancestor:event`), archive documents (`archive:document`), tree nodes (`familytree:node`).
app: Genealogy and family-history research — tree platforms (Ancestry, FamilySearch), DNA match exports (23andMe, MyHeritage), and document / archive catalogues — streamed to Splunk HEC via GEDCOM and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:record
| stats sum(eval(if(has_source="yes",1,0))) as sourced, count as facts
| eval coverage_pct=round(100*sourced/facts,1), unsourced=facts-sourced
description: Measures what share of the facts in your tree are backed by a real document rather than a guess or a copied tree.
value: Sourced facts are the difference between a reliable family history and a house of cards; coverage keeps you honest.
implementation: Ingest tree facts and their sources into `index=personal`; compute the sourced share.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much of your family tree is backed by real records, so your history rests on proof not guesswork.
